issue.title: [Bug]: [T2 Chassis] 'test_snmp_lldp' test case fails on the latest master image

failure.body:
### Issue Description

On the latest master image, for T2 Chassis, test case '_**test_snmp_lldp**_' fails, which checks for ieee802_1ab MIBs.

### Results you see

For example, the following LLDP MIB queries are failing as part of the test,

        # From LLDP-MIB: lldpLocManAddrTables
        _self.lldpLocManAddrLen = dp + "1.0.8802.<IP>.<IP>"  # + .subtype + .man addr
        self.lldpLocManAddrIfSubtype = dp + \
            "1.0.8802.<IP>.<IP>"  # + .subtype + .man addr
        self.lldpLocManAddrIfId = dp + "1.0.8802.<IP>.<IP>"  # + .subtype + .man addr
        self.lldpLocManAddrOID = dp + "1.0.8802.<IP>.<IP>"  # + .subtype + .man addr_

Test failure shown below:

```
      # Check if lldpLocManAddrTable is present
       for k in ['lldpLocManAddrLen',
                  'lldpLocManAddrIfSubtype',
                  'lldpLocManAddrIfId',
                  'lldpLocManAddrOID']:
       assert snmp_facts['snmp_lldp'][k]
       E           KeyError: 'lldpLocManAddrLen'
```
**Expected:**
gitlab-runner@cb1bef4b2896:$
_snmpwalk -v 2c -c public <host_ip> 1.0.8802.<IP>.3.8
iso.0.8802.<IP>.<IP>.<IP>.151.181 = INTEGER: 5
iso.0.8802.<IP>.<IP>.<IP>.151.181 = INTEGER: 2
iso.0.8802.<IP>.<IP>.<IP>.151.181 = INTEGER: 0
iso.0.8802.<IP>.<IP>.<IP>.151.181 = OID: iso.<IP>.<IP>.1_
**Actual:**
gitlab-runner@cb1bef4b2896:$ snmpwalk -v 2c -c public <host_ip> 1.0.8802.<IP>.3.8
**_iso.0.8802.<IP>.3.8 = No Such Object available on this agent at this OID_**
gitlab-runner@cb1bef4b2896:~$

### Results you expected to see

'test_snmp_lldp' test case is expected to pass.

This test started failing after the PR #13115 has been taken, where lldp container is removed from host instances.

### Is it platform specific

generic

### Relevant log output

```shell
gitlab-runner@cb1bef4b2896:~$ snmpwalk -v 2c -c public <IP> 1.0.8802.<IP>.3.8
iso.0.8802.<IP>.<IP>.<IP>.151.181 = INTEGER: 5

iso.0.8802.<IP>.<IP>.<IP>.151.181 = INTEGER: 0
iso.0.8802.<IP>.<IP>.<IP>.151.181 = OID: iso.<IP>.<IP>.1
gitlab-runner@cb1bef4b2896:~$ snmpwalk -v 2c -c public <IP> 1.0.8802.<IP>.3.8
iso.0.8802.<IP>.3.8 = No Such Object available on this agent at this OID

```
